text:
jo_support: FYI LuminaRetail onboarding is blocked - SSO token exchange intermittently failing + onboarding API returning 429 on provisioning calls. Seen in ~25% of flows. Ticket 90021.
lina_csm: Oof. Any customer impact beyond onboarding? Renewal due in 6 weeks for this account.
jo_support: No data loss, just cannot complete account creation. Logs show both 429 and occasional 500 on the /provision endpoint. Snippet:
```
HTTP 429: rate limit exceeded for client_id: lumina-123
ERROR: oidc: code exchange failed: invalid_grant
```
dan_se: I'm going to spin up a staging repro and check IdP time skew + our rate limiter config. ETA 20m.
mike_ops: I'll create an incident bridge and add a temporary alert for provisioning error rate > 15% for 10m. ops-bot: Created #incident-luminaretail-2777777000 and scheduled bridge -> https://meet.redwood/incident/luminaretail
lina_csm: Comms plan (short): 1) Immediate note to Lumina primary + engineering contact acknowledging block and next steps. 2) Provide temporary manual onboarding path + estimated ETA. 3) Flag renewal team and sales for potential impact. 4) Follow-up postmortem + credits discussion if SLA affected. I can draft the note.
jo_support: Manual onboarding workaround: create account via admin console using temporary API key (steps included). Also ask IdP admin to verify clock sync and token lifetimes. Add to the email.
dan_se: Repro in staging shows token TTL boundaries + our strict match on aud claim causing invalid_grant. Quick fix: relax aud equality check for the onboarding flow and add tolerant TTL window. Will test patch in canary.
lina_csm: If this escalates, recommend exec outreach + $X credit offer. Tagging @vp_cs for visibility.
ops-bot: Canary deployment at 14:12 UTC. Rolling to 2 nodes. Monitor: deploy succeeded.
dan_se: Canary passed basic flows. Rolling to prod now (rolling restart). Will watch for error rate.
mike_ops: Added rollback window and runbook entry. Also extended rate limiter burst allowance for provisioning service to reduce 429 spikes.
jo_support: Sent initial customer note (cc @lina_csm) with manual onboarding steps and we asked for IdP admin check. :email:
lina_csm: Received acknowledgement from customer; tech lead will try manual path and report back. I'll prepare renewal impact note and put Lumina on the high-touch list until fully stable.
dan_se: Prod rollout looks good so far - 5m stable, provisioning 429s dropped below threshold. Still monitoring for 30m.
jo_support: Support will continue to observe and validate with the customer. Handing to CS for relationship/renewal follow-up once we reach 2h stable.
lina_csm: Acknowledged. Next steps for CS: 1) Draft customer-friendly summary + timeline. 2) Schedule check-in with Lumina tech lead tomorrow. 3) Add item to renewal tracker: "onboarding interruption - monitor adoption metrics for 7 days".
vp_cs: Thanks for the heads-up. Please include the proposed credit language in the postmortem and keep me posted if we need executive outreach.
ops-bot: Incident status -> monitoring. Channel will auto-archive in 24h unless reopened.
lina_csm: Closing the loop here 97 postmortem draft in Confluence by EOD, customer summary + scheduled check-in. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
